back: A packaged workbook. It saves the workbook with all referenced local file data sources and images in a single file, so the recipient needs no separate data access.
A `.twb` holds only the workbook, so the recipient also needs access to the data. A `.twbx` packages the workbook with its local data.

front: How do you save a packaged workbook?
back: Select File > Save As, then choose Tableau Packaged Workbooks in the Save as type drop-down list.

front: How do you export a sheet as an image?
back: Select Worksheet > Export > Image, choose what to include, and save as BMP, JPEG, PNG or SVG.

front: How do you create a PDF of your workbook?
back: Select File > Print to PDF. Choose Entire Workbook, Active Sheet or Selected Sheets, plus a paper size.

front: How do you publish a workbook to Tableau Server or Tableau Cloud?
back: Select Server > Publish Workbook with a worksheet or dashboard tab active, sign in, then pick the project, a name and tags.
A `.twbx` is one file for someone who has Tableau. Publishing puts the workbook on Tableau Server or Tableau Cloud for viewers in a browser, with permissions.

front: Does hiding sheets before publishing protect them?
back: No. Hiding sheets is not a security measure: anyone with access can still reach hidden sheets. Use permissions.
Shows the data behind a view or a mark. Open it from a mark tooltip, by right-clicking the view, or from the Analysis menu.

front: Summary tab vs. Full Data tab in View Data
back: Summary shows the dimensions that define the view and the aggregated measures that make up the mark. Full Data lists the underlying rows. For the records behind a bar, use Full Data.

front: How do you export all data in a View Data tab?
back: Click the Download button. It saves a CSV file and is not limited to the rows currently displayed.

front: Export > Data vs. Export > Crosstab to Excel
back: Worksheet > Export > Data exports the data behind the view (Access database on Windows, .csv on Mac). Crosstab to Excel exports the table as laid out in the view.

front: How do you export to PowerPoint?
back: Select File > Export as PowerPoint and choose the sheets.

front: What do PowerPoint slides from Tableau contain?
back: Selected sheets become static PNG images on separate slides. Filters currently applied are reflected, but slides are not interactive and do not update with the data.

front: How do story points export to PowerPoint?
back: Story points export as separate slides.
